title: card.returned payload, schemaVersion 2
description: A card left the table. Bidirectional: sent tabletop->shuffler (dragged off the playmat back into the Shuffler's game state — ticket 12's library portal) and, as of ticket 07, shuffler->tabletop (any transition out of the Shuffler's own Table location — the Return button, or a crafted put-in-hand/top/bottom — via `occurredIn: "shuffler"`), so a consumer must branch on `occurredIn` rather than assume a direction. The table isn't authoritative for a table card's face, so unlike card.played/card.discarded this event carries no `face` field (two-faced-cards watch point 19) — `face` is explicitly blacklisted (`"face": false`) rather than merely undeclared, since a sender copying card.played's shape by habit is the likely mistake to guard against; every other unknown property still passes through per the fleet's additionalProperties:true policy. Identity is cardDefinitionId plus gameCardIndex (the Shuffler's own decklist rank), same as always — `card.instanceId` is an additional, optional identifier: the Shuffler always has it for a Table card (minted at newGame, already used by card.played) and now sends it too, so the Tabletop can poof the matching shape by its `instanceId` prop; a tabletop-initiated send may omit it.

cardDefinitionId.description: The card definition: the exact printing — oracle identity, all faces, all names, all images derivable. A UUID; for a Scryfall card it is the Scryfall id.

instanceId.description: The Shuffler's per-play GUID for this physical card (same value card.played sends). Optional — present on a shuffler-initiated card.returned (ticket 07, so the Tabletop can find the shape to remove); may be absent on a tabletop-initiated one.

gameCardIndex.description: The card's index in the Shuffler's initial decklist array (its alphabetical rank in that list) — how the Shuffler looks this card back up in its own game state.

seat.description: The seatId of the player this card is returning to — a bare non-empty check, matching card.played.v2's `owner` field.

fromZone.description: Where on the table the card was returning from. A hint — geography, not rules.
